title: Lefschetz recruited for nonlinear group, later moved to Brown

tellings.quote: why was solomon left schetz the great topologist recruited to be involved with louis whitten and to have an entire non-linear group working on mathematics that then gets moved to brown university when i believe that these programs are sunsetted

plain: In the 1950s, by this account, the great topologist Solomon Lefschetz was recruited to work alongside the physicist Louis Witten at the Glenn Martin Company, an aircraft maker, where a whole group worked on nonlinear mathematics. That work was then moved to Brown University, which the mathematician Eric Weinstein believes happened when the programmes were wound down. Weinstein raises it with Michels as a pointed question, naming no source, to hint that serious science was done in these programmes and then quietly shut away.
